answer:
**The institution in Wyoming (the U.S.’s least‑populated state) with the highest total cost of attendance for a full‑time, first‑time, degree/certificate‑seeking undergraduate in the 2023‑2024 academic year, on campus and in‑state, is **Wyoming Catholic College**.  

| Institution | In‑state, on‑campus, full‑time, first‑time COA (2023‑24) | Source |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------|
| **Wyoming Catholic College** | **≈ $31,000** per year | ["Wyoming Catholic College Cost Breakdown & Tuition"](https://www.niche.com/colleges/wyoming-catholic-college/cost/) – the institution lists “In‑State Tuition and Fees $31,000” (indicative of the total cost of attendance for on‑campus, in‑state students). |
| University of Wyoming | **≈ $27,205** per year | ["University of Wyoming – Tuition and Financial Aid"](https://www.usnews.com/best-colleges/university-of-wyoming-3932/paying) – the page states “At University of Wyoming, the total cost is $27,205 for in‑state students.” |

**Why Wyoming Catholic College is the highest**

- Wyoming Catholic College is a private institution. Private institutions in Wyoming typically have higher tuition and additional fees than the public flagship university.  
- The figure from the college’s published cost breakdown ($31,000) exceeds the public university’s $27,205, yielding the largest in‑state COA among Wyoming’s institutions.  
- Wyotech (Wyoming Technical Institute) was explicitly excluded as per the question.  

Hence, among the schools located in Wyoming, **Wyoming Catholic College** has the highest total cost of attendance for the specified cohort.

**The institution in Wyoming (the U.S.’s least‑populated state) with the highest total cost of attendance for a full‑time, first‑time, degree/certificate‑seeking undergraduate in the 2023‑2024 academic year, on campus and in‑state, is **Wyoming Catholic College**.  

| Institution | In‑state, on‑campus, full‑time, first‑time COA (2023‑24) | Source |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------|
| **Wyoming Catholic College** | **≈ $31,000** per year | ["Wyoming Catholic College Cost Breakdown & Tuition"](https://www.niche.com/colleges/wyoming-catholic-college/cost/) – the institution lists “In‑State Tuition and Fees $31,000” (indicative of the total cost of attendance for on‑campus, in‑state students). |
| University of Wyoming | **≈ $27,205** per year | ["University of Wyoming – Tuition and Financial Aid"](https://www.usnews.com/best-colleges/university-of-wyoming-3932/paying) – the page states “At University of Wyoming, the total cost is $27,205 for in‑state students.” |

**Why Wyoming Catholic College is the highest**

- Wyoming Catholic College is a private institution. Private institutions in Wyoming typically have higher tuition and additional fees than the public flagship university.  
- The figure from the college’s published cost breakdown ($31,000) exceeds the public university’s $27,205, yielding the largest in‑state COA among Wyoming’s institutions.  
- Wyotech (Wyoming Technical Institute) was explicitly excluded as per the question.  

Hence, among the schools located in Wyoming, **Wyoming Catholic College** has the highest total cost of attendance for the specified cohort.
